replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states unencrypted dumps in a shared bucket; over-broad grant exposing data is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Shared writable bucket with no integrity check; backup poisoning on restore is distinct from T1."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Deletion/overwrite of backups causing recovery loss is a distinct harm from tampering."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design grants reporting team bucket access; bypassing app-level controls via restore is concrete."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Team-shared bucket supports attribution gap; distinct repudiation harm, not merely generic hygiene."}]}
